purpose: Make every Structure input strictly read-only and require every writable output location to be isolated from every input location.

model.inputs: One or more read-only repositories and/or directories. Inputs may be identical to or overlap other inputs.
model.output: A writable repository and/or directory used for generated CW, mappings, plans, reports, exports or other Structure artifacts.

invariants: Structure MUST NOT write, modify, delete, commit, generate or persist anything inside an input repository or input directory.
Any number of inputs MAY refer to the same repository, the same directory, overlapping directories or different parts of the same repository because inputs are read-only.
The output MUST be validated against every input before the first write.
If output.repository resolves to the same repository identity as any input.repository, the operation MUST fail regardless of branch or subdirectory.
If output.directory resolves to the same filesystem directory as any input.directory, the operation MUST fail.
If output.directory is inside any input.directory, the operation MUST fail.
If any input.directory is inside output.directory, the operation MUST fail.
Repository aliases, URL forms, trailing .git suffixes and case differences MUST be normalized before comparison where the repository scheme permits it.
Filesystem paths MUST be expanded and resolved to canonical real paths before comparison.
Symbolic-link and relative-path aliases resolving to overlapping directory trees count as overlap.
There is no override, force flag, confirmation mode or privileged bypass for this invariant.
Failure MUST occur before any target mutation.
The rule applies to Structure Mapper, Planner, Projector export/generation paths, Compare/Conformance outputs and every future Structure writer.

examples: Specification and implementation may be read from the same repository.
Multiple detectors may read the same source tree.
A CW specification and native code may be separate read-only views of one repository snapshot.

failure.message: Structure output must be isolated from every read-only input repository and directory.

non_rules: This contract does not require inputs to be isolated from one another.
This contract does not infer equivalence between unrelated repository and filesystem locators when equivalence cannot be proven.
